name: row-minimap
title: Row minimap
description: Every record as a small mark on one strip, in the order sent and coloured by status. A draggable lens lists the records under it, and a profile counts the records that differ in each field.
needs: Records in a meaningful order (such as key order). Runs of agreeing records can be sent as one status-only record with a `count`. The server accepts up to 20,000 records per request.

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: Every {unitOne} at once, in the order sent. Scattered marks are one-off differences. A solid block is a run that differs together. Move the lens along the strip to read the {unit} underneath it.
text.mapSub: Select anywhere on the strip, or drag the lens, to read the {unit} under it.
text.mapLabel: Minimap of every {unitOne}, coloured by status
text.profSub: {unit} with a difference in each field.
text.lensAllAgree: Everything under the lens agrees. The first {shown} are shown.
text.empty: There are no records to draw.

options.name: lensRows
options.description: How many consecutive rows the lens covers.
